name: English - Academic Writing C2
description: The class will consist of in-class peer group sessions as well as written essays which will be subject to a series of revision. The students will be expected to critically evaluate model essays as well as their own writing in order to produce a polished finished product, which will reflect the kinds of academic writing they will be expected to do during their studies.
prerequisites: This is a C2 level course and you need to complete the placement test before the first lesson (bring a printout if your result!).
